annotations.title: Building material price and stock in Dutch stores (bouwmaterialen prijs)

description: Current price and stock of one building material in Dutch stores (bouwmaterialen prijs, prijs gipsplaat, building material price Netherlands). Call it when someone needs the price or availability of a specific product, given as a GTIN or EAN barcode, a store product link, or plain words to get candidates first. Returns each offer of the same trade item with the price in EUR including VAT, stock and read time per store, the identical item at other stores, the cheapest available offer and the status of each source; a Dutch postcode adds delivery cost in EUR and dates. Seller prices at read time, not a quote; it never orders, reserves or pays. Same input and answer as check_material. Read-only, free.

detail.description: short (default): at most three offers to show the person; full: every offer, delivery rule and source.

need_date.description: ISO planning date (YYYY-MM-DD), passed as the order date for delivery quotes; defaults to today in Europe/Amsterdam.

postcode.description: Dutch delivery postcode: 1234AB, 1234 AB or 1234. Adds per-offer delivery quotes.

quantity.description: Number of store units as sold, from 1 to 10000. Packs are not converted.

ref.description: a GTIN or EAN with valid check digit (e.g. 8710839100056), a Bouwmaat, Hubo or Houtdirect product link with ?variant=, a partner shop product link, store:variant (e.g. hubo:48564194312444), or plain words for candidates
